Name: Idle Timer
Author: LordAndreios
Description:
[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Simply install, after a period of inactivity you will be warned you are Idle, now instead of losing animals and plants from being afk far too long now you have no worries, if you fall asleep at your computer a lot this is just the mod for you!

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3 beta on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[/list]

[list]
[*]First Release
[*][url=https://github.com/emperorzuul/SMAPI_MODS/tree/master/PauseTimer]Source code[/url]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: IdleTimer
Manifest.Description: This mod watches to see if your character becomes idle.  If, after a set period of time, you are idle the game will pause.  Now you can play until you fall asleep without worry of waking up in winter!
Manifest.Author: LordAndreios
